## Intake: Batch 1, 10 carousels (all Branch A · static)

Pulled from the agency handoff (`app/handoff.md`). All 10 are final and approved. Format is already decided (static carousels), so there's no video branch this batch. **The Arabic on the slides is used exactly as approved.** Nothing gets rewritten to fit a layout; anything that doesn't fit gets flagged back to you.

| # | Post | Job | Slides | CTA |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | p5 · The vacuum: three things that take seconds | attention | 7 | — |
| 2 | p7 · The iPad: what comes after is ready first | conversion | 6 | الرابط في البايو. |
| 3 | p2 · The عزيمة: three calculations that matter | attention | 7 | — |
| 4 | p10 · He cries: three things to notice before guessing | conversion | 7 | الرابط في البايو. |
| 5 | p3 · Lying beside him: step back bit by bit | attention | 8 | — |
| 6 | p6 · Leaving the house: the 15 minutes before the shoes | conversion | 7 | الرابط في البايو. |
| 7 | p4 · His own plate: find what his three foods share | attention | 7 | — |
| 8 | p9 · His name vs the fridge door: four steps | conversion | 8 | الرابط في البايو. |
| 9 | p1 · Coming back from the park starts when you arrive | attention | 7 | — |
| 10 | p8 · Change isn't defiance: when someone else does bedtime | conversion | 8 | الرابط في البايو. |

### I need three answers before we start
1. **Platform and size.** TikTok photo carousels look best at **1080×1920 (9:16)**, and Instagram carousels at **1080×1350 (4:5)**. Which one, or both (each post laid out twice)? My recommendation: **1080×1350** as the master, because it works on Instagram and still displays on TikTok.
2. **Brand files.** I found no brand identity file in the project. Your website uses **El Messiri** (headings) and **Tajawal** (body), with a teal (#008C95 / #005A70) and warm sand (#C9935A) palette. Is that the brand? And do you have the paper-art style files or examples (or a Canva Brand Kit)? The Art Director reads them before stage 3.
3. **How to build.** **Canva** (real editable designs filed in your "Home Orbit social media" folder), **rendered PNGs** here (finished images you can post directly), or both. Recommendation: **both**. PNGs give you a guaranteed result with correct Arabic, and Canva gives you editable versions.

Optional: send 3–6 of your recent posts (screenshots or Canva links), so the Visual Researcher can make sure this batch *doesn't* look like the last one.


---
### Anhar's answers
- **Size:** 1080×1350 (4:5) for all 10.
- **Fonts:** El Messiri (headings) + Tajawal (body).
- **Brand kit:** it's in a docs file in Anhar's Claude project, not in Canva. ⚠ **The colours didn't come through in chat.** We need them before stage 3. For now, the website's teal (#008C95 / #005A70) and sand (#C9935A) are placeholders.
- **Build:** both. Canva (filed in "Home Orbit social media") **and** rendered PNGs.

---
# Visual Direction: Batch 1 (10 static carousels)

## 1. What's working now

1. **Slide 1 does the work.** The first slide decides the swipe. Use one bold, high-contrast line plus a visible promise: the question big, the second clause small. ([trymypost](https://www.trymypost.com/blog/instagram-carousel-hook-design-principles-2026), [postnitro](https://postnitro.ai/blog/post/instagram-carousel-design))
2. **One focal point that reads as a thumbnail.** One object or event, nothing competing. ([Adobe](https://www.adobe.com/express/learn/blog/social-media-photography-tips), [adlibrary](https://adlibrary.com/posts/scroll-stopping-ad-images))
3. **Handmade beats polished.** 2026 forecasts point to paper texture and collage as a reaction against AI-smooth visuals. ([Creative Bloq](https://www.creativebloq.com/design/graphic-design/texture-warmth-and-tactile-rebellion-the-big-graphic-design-trends-for-2026), [Inkish](https://inkish.news/en/article/2026-design-trend-forecast-says-brands-will-win-with-imperfect-human-visuals))
4. **One metaphor, layered paper, real shadow.** Eiko Ojala is the benchmark: minimal, lit, one idea per piece. ([Colossal](https://www.thisiscolossal.com/2017/10/new-paper-textured-editorial-illustrations-by-eiko-ojala/))
5. **Step carousels with visible progress.** Numbering, one idea and ≤4 lines per slide, and a final slide that looks different. ([kivopost](https://kivopost.com/glossary/content-types-creative-formats-styles/step-by-step-carousel))
6. **Colour-blocking in a checkerboard.** Flat colour fields are legible. Rotating 2–3 grounds across posts keeps the grid from blurring. ([colorpick](https://colorpick-app.pages.dev/blog/color-social-media-design))
7. **Photo + paper hybrids.** Real photos with cut-paper overlays, a growing editorial pattern. ([visie](https://visie.io/article/the-art-of-the-mash-up-7-collage-illustrators-turning-chaos-into-beauty))

**Arabic:**
- Design RTL-native; don't mirror a Latin layout.
- Numerals don't mirror.
- Heavy weights get dark, so cap El Messiri at 700.
- Swipe order runs right to left. ([type guide](https://englishtoarabic-org.pages.dev/calligraphy/typography/))

**Caveat:** The performance numbers come from vendor blogs, so treat them as directional. That includes TikTok carousels "+81% engagement vs video" ([Fanpage Karma](https://www.fanpagekarma.com/insights/carousel-vs-video-performance-tiktok-instagram/)) and [Socialinsider's](https://www.socialinsider.io/data-geeks/Instagram-Carousel-Study.pdf) carousel ER. I found no study comparing text-led and illustrated carousels, so §5 tests it.

## 2. Recent Home Orbit work

**"Too Much" (animation and storyboard):**
- A 9:16 side-view night room diorama: deep-teal wall, floor band, oval rug, window and moon.
- Paper puppets for the mother and child.
- Scattered props: checklists, a clock, toys.
- Text on a teal strip rotated −1° at the top.
- The "paper" is only stacked drop shadows on flat CSS shapes, with no grain or torn edges.

**"Leaving Grandma's":**
- The same side-view room diorama, warm and in daylight: cream, brown furniture, sofa, door, three figures.
- 84px white rounded caption cards in Alexandria (off-brand), with emoji (💀😂), which is off-tone.

**Repetition risk:**
- The same wide room, the same puppets and the same top text label. Ten more dioramas would make the grid identical.
- The paper also reads as vector rather than paper.

## 3. The look for this batch

**Through-line (recognisable):**
- **Real paper material.** Visible grain, edges that are slightly irregular rather than vector-perfect, and a tight contact shadow plus a soft cast shadow. Shapes overlap.
- **Type.** El Messiri 700 for hooks at 88–110px. Tajawal 500 for body at 46–54px. Max 3 lines per slide.
- **Signature step tab.** Labels («أول شي», «الخطوة الثانية», «الحساب الثالث») sit on a small torn sand-paper tab, top-right, with paper progress dots.
- **Endings.** Every conversion post ends on a sand ground with the same paper "link in bio" tag. Attention posts end on one quiet line.
- **No faces on the child.** Show hands, his back, feet and objects. This is respectful, avoids puppets, and is easier to render.

**What varies:** composition family, ground colour (checkerboard across the grid), point of view (side, top-down, macro), and hero scale.

**Grounds:** sand #C9935A, light teal #DCE8EA, deep teal #005A70, paper white #F7F2EA, and deep brown #3A2410 (once).

## 4. Per-post direction (posting order)

| # | Post | First-slide idea | Family | Colour | Text |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **p5 vacuum** | A huge paper vacuum. Torn-paper "noise" strips burst out. In a far corner, small paper hands cover ears. | One Big Object | Light teal, sand, deep-teal strips | Hook 100px top-right. In the steps the vacuum shrinks and moves away. |
| 2 | **p7 iPad** | Split frame: a glowing iPad on the right (read first), a biscuit plate already waiting on the left. | Split | Deep teal + warm sand | Question over the iPad, «جهزي اللي بعده» over the plate. |
| 3 | **p2 عزيمة** | Top-down paper majlis plan: cushions, TV, speaker, door. The seat by the door is circled in sand. | Top-down Map | Paper white, teal, brown lines | Each «الحساب» slide highlights one zone of the same map. |
| 4 | **p10 crying** | One paper teardrop with three blank torn notes pinned around it. | Clue Board | Sand, white notes | Each step fills a note: the iPad off, a puzzle piece, a blender. |
| 5 | **p3 bedtime** | Seamless panorama. A bed and mum's slipper beside it under a paper moon. Her chair moves across the slides toward the door. | Panorama Path | Deep-teal night, one warm lamp | White hook on the dark ground. Tabs ride above. |
| 6 | **p6 shoes** | A giant paper clock. Small shoes sit at 12, and the quarter-hour before them is a sand wedge. | One Big Object | Deep brown, sand, white | The wedge shows «ربع الساعة». |
| 7 | **p4 plate** | Overhead: nuggets, fries and toast, all golden paper, with a tiny empty plate beside. | Top-down Flat-lay | Light teal, golden | Slide 3 circles "crunchy golden". Slide 5 adds falafel. |
| 8 | **p9 name vs fridge** | A huge glowing fridge door ajar. A tiny paper speech bubble holds his name in the corner. | Split / Scale | White + deep teal | The long hook is split: the first clause big, the second at body size. The bubble grows each step. |
| 9 | **p1 park** | A real top-down photo of grass and a blanket. A paper car is pinned at the edge, with a paper path from the blanket. | Photo + Paper | Natural green + paper | Hook on a torn white strip. Items get packed in order: food bag, toys, blanket. |
| 10 | **p8 aunt bedtime** | Type only: «مو كل رفض عناد» at around 130px in layered paper, with one story book below. | Type-first | Sand, deep-teal type | Inner slides are small object vignettes (book stays with mum, pyjamas to the aunt). |

**Adjacency:** BO → Split → Map → Board → Panorama → BO → Flat-lay → Split → Hybrid → Type. No neighbours repeat, and light and dark grounds alternate across the grid.

## 5. Fresh directions to test

1. **Type-first big Arabic.**
   - Try it on **p8** (a statement hook) and as an A/B slide 1 on **p10**.
   - It's the cheapest option and the most legible, and it answers the text-versus-illustration question with our own data.
2. **Single paper object hero.**
   - Try it on **p5** and **p6**.
   - It reads at thumbnail size, needs no puppets, and makes the clearest break from the dioramas.
3. **Photo + paper hybrid.**
   - Try it on **p1**, and as an alternate on **p4** with a real plate shot from above.
   - The real setting makes it feel like her life. It needs licensed or own photos with no faces.

The p3 panorama is a small fourth test, aimed at swipe completion.

## 6. Production realism (HTML/CSS → PNG)

**Renders well in Chromium at 1080×1350:**
- `clip-path` and SVG cut shapes.
- Grain via SVG `feTurbulence` (fractalNoise at about 0.04 and 4–5 octaves, 6–10% opacity). See [Codrops](https://tympanus.net/codrops/2019/02/19/svg-filter-effects-creating-texture-with-feturbulence/) and [CSS-Tricks](https://css-tricks.com/?p=351302).
- Torn edges via `feDisplacementMap` or jagged polygons.
- Layered shadows.
- Arabic RTL with El Messiri and Tajawal.
- Tabs and dots, maps, clocks and flat food shapes.
- Type-only slides.
- Panoramas: render one wide canvas, then slice it.

**Needs Canva, illustration or photos:**
- Large figurative hands and bodies (keep them small and simplified, or use SVG illustration).
- Realistic food.
- The p1/p4 photo bases: source in Canva or stock, then composite paper in HTML.
- A one-time real paper scan as an uploaded texture would beat procedural grain.

**Rule:** 6–12 shapes per slide. Detail costs legibility.

### Anhar approved, with two rules
- **Blue is the primary colour. Pearl must not dominate.** Updated grounds: p7 is now Deep Sea + pale teal (was pearl), p6 is now Sunrise Gold (was pearl). Only p8 (type-first, big blue type) keeps a pearl ground. That makes 6 of 10 posts blue-dominant.
- **Recognisable, not identical.** "If it all looks the same, it's another version of apathy."
- **Long slides:** Option B. The 5 red slides are split at an existing line break, with the same words.

## Director's summary
- **Through-line:** cut paper on a flat colour ground: grain, torn edges, light from the top-right. Hooks in El Messiri at ~96px, body in Tajawal at 50–60px, never below 44px. A torn gold step tab, paper progress dots, no slide numbers.
- **Grid:** dark and light grounds alternate in posting order. No two neighbours share a composition.
- **p1 park:** the photo is replaced by a top-down paper route map (teal lawn, gold blanket, dashed path to a paper car).
- **Conversion end slides:** gold ground, with the post's own last line on a pearl tag. No words added.
- **Contrast-safe pairs only:** gold text on Deep Sea and white on Ocean Teal are banned (too low contrast).

### ⚠ Decision needed: long slides
Ten slides are long enough that they can't stay *big* and readable at a glance. The designers **won't change your Arabic**. Choose one option per group:
- **Red** (more than 5 lines at the minimum size, or the hook shrinks):
  - p7 slide 6 (the bridge, 151 characters)
  - p9 slide 1 hook (124)
  - p3 slide 7 (123)
  - p2 slide 7 (120)
  - p7 slide 4 (111)
- **Amber** (fits, but tight): p6 s5, p8 s8, p2 s3, p6 s7, p8 s1, p5 s5, p2 s2, p9 s8, p1 s4, p4 s6.

**Options:**
- **A.** Set them as they are, smaller and tighter. Fastest, but they'll read more like a wall of text.
- **B.** Split each red slide into two slides at its existing line break or full stop. Same words, more slides.
- **C.** You shorten the red ones yourself.

**Recommendation:** **B** for the red ones, **A** for the amber ones.

# Art Direction: Batch 1

Values: `art_tokens.json`.

## 1. Through-line

Real paper on flat colour, lit from the top-right. Composition, viewpoint, scale and ground change per post; the material never does.

- **Grain:** one SVG filter on every shape. Mottle is fractalNoise 0.035, 3 octaves, 5%. Fibre is fractalNoise 0.9, 4 octaves, 7%, multiply. The ground gets 4%. Seeds are fixed.
- **Edges:** torn edges are jagged polygons (6–12px amplitude, every 10–18px) over a pearl core offset 3px at 70%. Cut edges use feDisplacementMap at scale 3.
- **Shadows:** every layer gets a contact shadow (−1 2 2px, ink 28%) and a cast shadow (−6 10 18px, ink 18%). On dark grounds both use #00141A at 45% and 35%. Each higher layer adds 4px of cast offset, plus a 1px white highlight at the top-right.
- **Safe area:** margins are 96px at the sides, 120px at the top and 150px at the bottom, giving an 888×1080 text box. Keep key content 60px or more from the sides, because the profile grid crops to 3:4.
- **Type** (px at 1080 wide, with line-height):

| Role | Font | Size | LH |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hook | El Messiri 700 | 96 (88–110) | 1.35 |
| Hook second clause | Tajawal 500 | 54 | 1.5 |
| Type-first hook (p8) | El Messiri 700 | 120 | 1.3 |
| Step label | El Messiri 600 | 44 | 1.2 |
| Body lead | Tajawal 700 | 60 | 1.45 |
| Body support (after "\n") | Tajawal 500 | 50 | 1.5 |
| Quiet end line | El Messiri 600 | 72 | 1.4 |
| Tag | Tajawal 700 | 46 | 1.3 |
| Floor | – | 44 | – |

- **Step tab:** a torn gold strip at the top-right, 72px tall and rotated −2°, with ink text. It holds the slide's own label up to the colon («الخطوة الأولى:»). The rest follows as body, so nothing is duplicated.
- **Dots:** 14px paper discs with 12px gaps, at bottom-centre 72px up. The current slide's dot is a 20px gold disc; the rest are the text colour at 40%. They run right to left, slide 1 has none, and there are no slide numbers.
- **Conversion end:** a full gold ground with ink text. The motif returns at 25% size in the bottom-left. The existing last sentence sits on a pearl torn tag (−3°, punched hole, deep string): «الرابط في البايو.» on p6/p7/p8/p10, and «التقييم المجاني في البايو يمر عليها كلها.» on p9.
- **Attention end:** own ground, quiet line centred at 72px, one motif accent.

## 2. Colour

- **Brand:** deep #005A70 · teal #00A9A5 · pearl #F6F3EB · gold #C9935A.
- **Derived:** night #003F4F (deep −30%) · ink #0E2F38 · tealMist #DCEEEC · sandLight #EBD6BC · goldDeep #8A5A2B · tealDeep #007A77.
- **Grounds:**
  - Light: pearl, tealMist, sandLight.
  - Dark: deep, night.
  - Gold is a ground on end slides only. Teal is never a ground.
- **Contrast** (WCAG 2.x): all text is 44px or larger, so the large-text threshold is 3:1, but I target 4.5:1.
  - **Pass:** ink on pearl 12.8, ink on tealMist 11.8, ink on sandLight 10.0, ink on gold 5.3, deep on pearl 7.0, pearl on deep 7.0, pearl on night 10.4.
  - **Accent only (≥60px):** gold on night 4.3.
  - **Banned:** gold on deep 2.9, deep on gold 2.9, pearl or white on teal 2.6–2.9, teal on pearl 2.6.

## 3. Per-post spec (posting order; grid D L D L D L D L D L)

**1. p5 vacuum.** Night ground, D. One Big Object (macro).
- Motif: a canister vacuum about 70% of the frame, bleeding off the bottom-left: pearl body ellipse, deep hose arc, gold wheels.
- Five torn teal and gold "noise" strips fan from the nozzle. Two small pearl mitten-hands cover an ear at the top-left.
- Slide 1: hook top-right in pearl, 96px, 3 lines.
- Inner slides: the vacuum shrinks (70→45→25%) and drifts left. On s6 a pearl doorway stays open. Accent: gold.

**2. p7 iPad.** Pearl ground with a tealMist right panel, L. Split frame with a torn seam.
- Right: a deep iPad (28px radius) with a two-layer teal glow.
- Left: a gold concentric plate holding four sandLight biscuits.
- Slide 1: the question sits over the iPad in ink at 96px; «جهزي اللي بعده قبل ما تسحبيه» sits over the plate at 54px.
- Inner slides: the plate side grows. On s4 a deep shower-head is crossed by a gold strip.

**3. p2 عزيمة.** Deep ground, D. Top-down blueprint.
- Motif: a majlis plan in pearl outline. A U of 8 sandLight cushions, a night TV bar, two speakers, and a door gap at the bottom-right. A torn gold ring marks the seat by the door.
- Slide 1: hook top-right in pearl, 92px, over the empty centre.
- Inner slides: each «الحساب» lifts one zone in gold: the arrival path, then the seat ring, then a gold bag holding a cup, a dish and a toy.

**4. p10 crying.** SandLight ground, L. Clue board.
- Motif: a cut deep teardrop (300px) at centre-low. Three blank pearl torn notes with gold pins sit around it.
- Slide 1: hook top-right in ink, 96px.
- Inner slides: each «شي» enlarges one note, which gains a flat deep icon: an iPad with an off-dot, then a puzzle piece, then a blender.

**5. p3 bedtime.** Night ground, D. Panorama: one 8640px strip, sliced.
- Motif: a side-view bed (deep frame, pearl blanket lump, no head), a gold slipper, a pearl moon and a gold lamp glow. Mum's gold chair moves bed → mid-room → door across s4–s8.
- Slide 1: hook centred in the upper third, pearl, 92px.
- Inner slides: a continuous floor line, with text in the upper 45%. On s8 the door is ajar with a light wedge.

**6. p6 shoes.** Pearl ground, L. One Big Object (centred radial).
- Motif: a 760px sandLight clock with a deep rim and ink hands. The quarter-hour before 12 is a torn gold wedge, and small deep shoes sit at 12.
- Slide 1: hook top-right in ink, 88px, with the clock filling the lower 60%.
- Inner slides: s4 an iPad with a gold cross; s5 a cup and a biscuit in the wedge; s6 the shoes move into the wedge.

**7. p4 plate.** Deep ground, D. Top-down flat-lay, geometric only.
- Motif: a 640px pearl plate. On it, four gold nugget blobs with sandLight dots, 7 gold fry bars, and a gold toast square with a goldDeep crust. An empty 200px dish sits beside it.
- Slide 1: hook top-right in pearl, 92px; the plate is cropped low.
- Inner slides: s3 a torn teal ring around the gold food; s4 the food turns pearl/deep; s5–7 a goldDeep falafel disc sits in the small dish.

**8. p9 name.** TealMist ground, L. Scale contrast.
- Motif: a giant deep fridge door ajar on the left, 70% of the frame height, with a pearl glow wedge. A tiny empty pearl speech bubble sits at the right.
- Slide 1: the clause up to «يلتفت؟» is set at 92px in ink; «جربي هذي…» follows at 50px.
- Inner slides: the bubble grows from 120 to 420px while the fridge recedes. On s4 a gold biscuit appears in the bubble.

**9. p1 park.** Deep ground with a teal lawn, D. Top-down route map. This replaces the photo hybrid.
- Motif: a torn teal lawn island over the lower 60%. A gold blanket with pearl stripes sits at the bottom-right, and a dashed pearl path runs from it to a small night car at the top-left.
- Slide 1: hook on a torn pearl strip (−1.5°) across the top third, ink, 88px.
- Inner slides: items travel the path. s3 a gold pin on the car; s4 the bag, then the ball, then the blanket lift off; s6 a juice box in the car.

**10. p8 aunt.** Pearl ground, L. Type-first.
- Motif: deep cut-paper letters over a gold duplicate offset −8px 8px, with one small closed storybook (gold cover).
- Slide 1: «مو كل مرة… يعاندك.» at 120px, and the rest at 54px.
- Inner slides: low vignettes. The book stays by a gold chair; striped pyjamas pass to a sandLight hand.

**Adjacency:** macro → split → map → board → panorama → radial → flat-lay → scale → route → type; neighbouring grounds always differ in value.

## 4. Brand check

All ten carry grain, double shadows, El Messiri hooks, gold tab and dots (plus the gold tag on conversion posts). Freshness against the side-view rooms:
- **p5:** one cropped object, with no room and no puppets.
- **p7:** a split object pair with no figures.
- **p2:** a plan view, not an elevation.
- **p10:** a symbolic board with no scene.
- **p3:** the closest to a room, but a sliced panorama with no figures.
- **p6:** a clock dial; time stands in for place.
- **p4:** an overhead flat-lay of geometric food.
- **p9:** extreme scale on a single object.
- **p1:** a map with a path and markers, not a landscape.
- **p8:** pure type and one prop.

## 5. Arabic setting

- `dir=rtl`, right-aligned. Centre only where specified, and never justify.
- Letter-spacing is 0. No synthetic bold, and El Messiri no heavier than 700.
- **Line breaks:**
  - Every "\n" is a hard break.
  - Otherwise, break only at a comma, a full stop or a phrase boundary.
  - Never split a construct pair, a preposition from its noun («بـ لا»), a quote, or a label from its colon.
  - Use `text-wrap: balance` on hooks and `pretty` on body to avoid widows.
- **Limits:** about 20 characters per line at 96px and 30–34 at 60px. A hook gets at most 4 lines, a slide at most 5. Add no numerals.
- **Legibility gate** (checked on the PNG):
  1. The hook reads at 270px wide.
  2. No text is under 44px.
  3. Contrast is 4.5:1 or better.
  4. No text crosses a motif.
  5. The safe area is respected.
  6. A diff against `slides_ar` is empty.
  7. The dots run right to left.

## 6. Fit flags (not rewritten)

**Red** (over 5 lines at 50px, or hook below 88px):
- p7 s6 (151 characters)
- p9 s1 hook (124)
- p3 s7 (123)
- p2 s7 (120)
- p7 s4 (111)

**Amber** (fits only at 50px, tight):
- p6 s5 (107)
- p8 s8 (107, no "\n")
- p2 s3 (103)
- p6 s7 (103)
- p8 s1 hook (101, needs the big/small split)
- p5 s5 (101)
- p2 s2 (99)
- p9 s8 (98)
- p1 s4 (95)
- p4 s6 (95)

**Split hooks:** p1 s1, p6 s1 (80 characters): question big, clause small.

**No "\n":** p8 s2–s7 break at full stops.

## Build complete: all 10 carousels (81 slides)

Every slide is 1080×1350, rendered with El Messiri + Tajawal. **Every slide's Arabic passed a letter-by-letter check against the approved copy**, with zero render failures. The 5 long slides were split at existing line breaks, with the same words.

| Order | Post | Slides | Ground | Composition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Vacuum | 7 | Night blue | One big object that shrinks |
| 2 | iPad | 8 | Deep Sea + pale teal | Torn diagonal split |
| 3 | The عزيمة | 8 | Deep Sea | Top-down majlis map |
| 4 | He cries | 7 | Light sand | Clue board (teardrop + pinned notes) |
| 5 | Bedtime | 9 | Night blue | Bedroom panorama, the chair walks to the door |
| 6 | Shoes | 7 | Sunrise Gold | One big clock, the gold quarter-hour |

# Creative QA: Batch 1 (10 carousels)

Date: 2026-11-04. Reviewer: Creative QA Specialist.

**Result: all 10 pass the Arabic legibility gate and are `qa-passed`. No post was sent back.** Scores flag where to improve; they are not verdicts.

## Ranking

| Rank | Post | Job | Score /100 | Gate | Status | One-line read |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | p10 | conversion | 87 | pass | qa-passed | Board fills as the copy lists: clearest story. |
| 2 | p6 | conversion | 87 | pass | qa-passed | Clock + quarter-hour wedge: instant concept; all-gold dulls the end. |
| 3 | p5 | attention | 85 | pass | qa-passed | Macro vacuum: best dark cover; middle repeats. |
| 4 | p1 | attention | 85 | pass | qa-passed | Pearl-strip hook + aerial map: distinctive; heavy teal. |
| 5 | p8 | conversion | 85 | pass | qa-passed | Type-first statement; small generic vignettes. |
| 6 | p3 | attention | 84 | pass | qa-passed | Most moving journey, but still the old side-view room genre. |
| 7 | p7 | conversion | 83 | pass | qa-passed | Glowing iPad split; plate duplicates p4. |
| 8 | p9 | conversion | 82 | pass | qa-passed | Clever scale gag; cover crop too tight, middle monotonous. |
| 9 | p4 | attention | 80 | pass | qa-passed | Clever middle, generic cover; too close to p7. |
| 10 | p2 | attention | 78 | pass | qa-passed | Smart plan view; cover doesn't read as a majlis. |

## Gate (Arabic legibility)

All 10 posts pass the Arabic legibility gate: verify.py verbatim PASS on all 10; El Messiri/Tajawal only; RTL; all text >=44px; no broken ligatures, clipping or text behind art seen in full-size review; contrast >=4.5:1 everywhere (lowest ink on gold 5.3:1). Non-blocking: renderer margin warnings on p5 and p2 slide 1 (hook to x=84-1000, inside the 96px margin but outside the 60px grid crop).

## Batch verdict

- **Dimensions:** All 81 slide PNGs are 1080x1350 (4:5). Correct for Instagram.
- **Blue leading:** Yes. 6 of 10 covers are deep/night-led (p5, p2, p3, p4, p1, plus p7's deep left panel), and deep is the main motif colour on p9 and p8. Pearl is a ground only on p8, as the override requires. Watch-outs: p6 is fully gold, and p1's lawn puts a large field of bright teal on the grid.
- **Grid:** Recognisable, not identical. The paper grain, torn edges, gold tabs and El Messiri hooks hold the feed together, while composition changes every post (macro, split, plan, board, panorama, radial, flat-lay, scale, map, type). In a 3-column profile the light and dark covers make a near checkerboard. This is a clear step away from the older wide side-view room scenes.
- **Too similar:**
  - p7 and p4: both use a round gold plate of dotted round biscuits/nuggets on a deep ground. Change one plate/food treatment.
  - p3 is the one post still in the old side-view room genre (bed, window, lamp, floor line). It is the most at risk of 'more of the same'.
- **Fix first:**
  - p2 cover: zoom out so the majlis reads at a glance (lowest attention score).
  - p4/p7 plate duplication.
  - p9 cover crop so the fridge reads as a fridge.

## Per post (posting order)

### p5 (attention, 7 slides): 85/100, gate pass, qa-passed

Strongest scroll-stopper in the dark half of the grid: a bold macro object a tired mum recognises instantly, with the hook in clean pearl El Messiri. The shrinking-vacuum device carries the 'start far away' logic well. Middle slides 2-3 are visually repetitive and the head/ear shape is slightly unclear.

| Item | Score | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Attention: first frame | 19/22 | Huge cropped pearl vacuum with torn noise strips firing at two mitten-hands stops the thumb; hook is big and high. The brown/tan disc behind the mittens is an ambiguous 'head' blob that takes a beat to read. |
| Visual clarity | 14/16 | One object per frame; text always sits clear of art. Slide 5's nested-squares 'far room' needs a second look. |
| Brand recognizability | 9/10 | Night ground, paper grain, double shadows, El Messiri hook, gold tabs and dots all present. |
| Freshness | 9/10 | Macro single object, no room, no puppets: clearly unlike the old side-view rooms. |
| Storytelling | 10/12 | Vacuum shrinks and drifts away as the advice moves it further from him; s6 open doorway lands 'path out'. |
| Retention | 9/12 | s2 and s3 are near-identical (mid-size vacuum on empty night), so the middle sags before the first step. |
| Production quality | 9/10 | Clean render; checker warns hook lines run to x=84-1000 (16px into the 96px margin) but still inside the 60px grid-crop zone. |
| Conversion support | 6/8 | Attention post: quiet end line centred with the tiny vacuum is a calm payoff; nothing pushes to save/share. |

**What would push it higher**

- Make the covered-ear figure unambiguous (a clearer hair/head silhouette, still faceless) so the 'he covers his ears' reading is instant.

حاولي توصلي بدري قبل ما يمتلئ المجلس. كذا يدخل والمكان لسه هادي.

وامشي وهو لسه مبسوط، مو بعد ما يبدأ الصياح.
الطلعة وهو مرتاح أخف عليك بكثير من الطلعة وكل العيون عليكم.

الحساب الثاني: فين تجلسي.
قريب من الباب، وهو جمبك، وبعيد عن التلفزيون والسماعات.
كذا لو احتاج يطلع شوي، تطلعوا بهدوء بدون ما تمروا قدام الكل.

الحساب الثالث: ايش يجي معاه من البيت.
كوبه، وأكلة يعرفها، وشي يمسكه بيده.

هذي الثلاث تنحسب في البيت قبل ما تطلعي.
عشان لما توصلي، تقدري تجلسي مع أهلك بدل ما تقضي العزيمة كلها وراه من غرفة لغرفة.
pieces.notes:
**QA 78/100 · gate pass**

Smart concept and on-brand, but the first frame is the weakest in the batch: the majlis plan is cropped into anonymous rectangles and nothing says 'gathering' at a glance. The inner slides explain themselves far better than the cover. Passes the gate; needs a stronger cover to earn the scroll.

**Push it higher:**
- Rebuild the cover so the full U of cushions, door gap and TV bar are visible below the hook (zoom out), so it reads as a majlis in one glance.
- Add one human-scale cue on the cover (e.g. a row of pearl slippers at the door or a dallah on a tray) to anchor 'عزيمة'.
- Move the hook 20px left/inward to clear the cushion column and the 96px margin flag.

pieces.title: He cries: three things to notice before guessing
onAsset_ar: يبكي وما تعرفي ايش يبغى؟ هذي ثلاث أشياء تلاحظيها قبل ما تبدئي تخمني.
تجيبي له موية، وبعدها أكل، وبعدها لعبته، وهو يبكي أكثر.

أول شي: ايش اللي صار قبل البكا بشوي.
الآيباد طفى أو رجعتوا من طلعه أو خلص الاكل اللي في صحنه.

ثاني شي: ايش كان يسوي لما بدأ.
يحاول يركب قطعة وما ركبت، أو يدور على لعبة وما لقاها.

ثالث شي: فين كان.
في المطبخ والخلاط شغال، أو في الصالة والتلفزيون عالي، أو في غرفة نورها قوي.

هذي الثلاث تلاحظيها في ثواني، وهو لسه يبكي.
كذا بدل ما تجربي كل شي، تبدئي من وحدة منهم.

إذا البكا يتكرر كل يوم، التقييم المجاني يساعدك تشوفي يومه كامل بدل ما تخمني.
الرابط في البايو.
pieces.notes:
**QA 87/100 · gate pass**

The clearest storytelling in the batch: the board fills up exactly as the copy lists the three things, and the end slide carries the board to the link. Cover is gentle rather than loud on the light sandLight ground.

**Push it higher:**
- Raise cover contrast: make the teardrop bigger (~380px) or add a thin deep string web so the cover pops among dark neighbours.
- On s2 (the guessing slide) show the water/food/toy items scattered and slightly crossed out to dramatise 'guessing'.
- Consider a tiny 'one note filled' hint on the cover to promise the payoff.

pieces.title: Lying beside him: step back bit by bit
onAsset_ar: تنسدحي جمبه إلين ما ينام، وتصحي بعد ساعتين وأنتي اللي نمتي؟

كل ليلة نفس القصة.
هو ما ينام إلا وأنتي جمبه، وأنتي تبغيه ينام لحاله.
هذي أربع خطوات تبعدي فيها عنه شوي شوي، بدون ما تختفي من الغرفة فجأة.

الخطوة الأولى: بدل ما تنسدحي جمبه، اجلسي جمب سريره.
نفس القرب، بس أنتي جالسة، وما راح تنامي قبله.

الخطوة الثانية: يدك على ظهره في البداية.
وبعد كم ليلة، صوتك بس، بدون يدك.

الخطوة الثالثة: كل كم ليلة، مكانك يبعد شوي.
من جمب السرير، لنص الغرفة، لعند الباب.

الخطوة الرابعة: إذا قام من سريره، رجعيه بهدوء وبنفس الكلمتين كل مرة، زي "يلا نوم".
بدون نقاش، وبدون ما تنسدحي جمبه من جديد.

تاخذ وقت، بس كل كم ليلة أنتي أبعد بخطوة.
والهدف ليلة تطلعي فيها من الغرفة وهو لسه صاحي.
pieces.notes:
**QA 84/100 · gate pass**

Emotionally the strongest idea and the best journey (the chair moving to the door is a great device). But visually it is the side-view room scene the brand is trying to move away from, so it risks feeling like the old feed. Execution is mostly clean; the hand on s5 looks pasted on.

**Push it higher:**
- Break the side-view sameness on the cover: e.g. a top-down view of the bed with two blanket lumps, then switch to the side panorama inside.
- Scale the s5 hand down and rest it on the blanket lump so it reads as 'hand on his back'.
- Lift the slide-9 dots above the light wedge or darken them so they don't wash out.

pieces.title: Leaving the house: the 15 minutes before the shoes
onAsset_ar: يبدأ الصراخ أول ما تجيبي الجزمة عشان تطلعوا؟ الفرق كله في الربع ساعة اللي قبلها.
لما تجي الجزمة وهو لسه مستمتع باللعب، طبيعي ما يبغى يوقف.
هذي ثلاث أشياء تسويها في الربع ساعة اللي قبل الطلعة.

قبل الطلعة بربع ساعة، لا تبدئي معاه شي جديد يحتاج وقت.
لا آيباد ولا غيره.

وخلي آخر شي قبل الطلعة حاجة بسيطة يخلصها على راحته.
عصير يشربه، أو بسكوتة ياكلها. يخلص منها، وبعدها تطلعوا.

لا تناديه يجي للباب عشان يلبس الجزمة.
خذيها له مكانه، ولبّسيه وهو جالس، وبعدها اطلعوا.

الطلعة موقف واحد بس.
التقييم المجاني يساعدك تشوفي الصورة الأكبر، وتعرفي من فين تبدئي.
الرابط في البايو.
pieces.notes:
**QA 87/100 · gate pass**

A strong, legible concept: the clock makes an abstract tip ('the quarter hour before') concrete. Gold ground was approved by Anhar, but it costs the end slide its signal and is the least blue cover in the batch.

**Push it higher:**
- Differentiate the end slide: put it on deep with a pearl panel, or make the inner slides sandLight so the gold end still lands as the 'action' slide.
- Keep the shoes visible on the end-slide mini clock (scale them up) so the motif reads.
- Add a deep-blue accent on the cover (e.g. darker rim or deep hands) so the post still contributes to the blue-led grid.

pieces.title: His own plate: find what his three foods share
onAsset_ar: تطبخي للبيت كله، وهو له صحن لحاله فيه نفس الثلاث أكلات كل يوم؟
قبل ما تجربي أكل جديد، لاحظي ايش يجمع الأكلات الثلاث اللي ياكلها.
إذا صحنه نقت وبطاطس وتوست، كلها مقرمشة ولونها ذهبي.
ومرات اللي يجمعها ماركة وحدة ما تتغير، أو إنها لازم تكون باردة.

ولما تلاحظي الشي المشترك، اختاري أكلة وحدة من السفرة فيها نفس الشي.
حبة فلافل، أو قطعة تميس.

لا تحطيها داخل صحنه، ولا تطلبي منه يذوقها.
حطيها في صحن صغير جمب صحنه، وخليها بدون ما تقولي شي.

إذا لمسها أو شمها، هذا يكفي اليوم.
وبكرة حطي نفس الأكلة، في نفس الصحن الصغير، جمب صحنه.
pieces.notes:
**QA 80/100 · gate pass**

Solid, clear and on-brand, with a clever middle (the s4 'cold/brand' transformation). The cover is the problem: a cropped plate of beige food on blue doesn't create tension, and it reads too close to p7's biscuit plate.

**Push it higher:**
- Make the cover about the contrast: the family's big shared dish (many colours) beside his small plate of the same three beige foods.
- Change the plate/food palette so p4 and p7 don't share 'round dotted gold items on a round plate on deep'.
- Bring the empty side dish forward on the cover so the 'what goes here?' question is visible.

pieces.title: His name vs the fridge door: four steps
onAsset_ar: يسمع باب الثلاجة من آخر البيت، ولما تناديه باسمه ما يلتفت؟ جربي هذي الأربع خطوات، وراح تبدئي تكتشفي ايش اللي يخليه يلتفت لك.

الخطوة الأولى: ناديه من قدامه، مو من وراه.
خليه يشوفك وأنتي تقولي اسمه.

الخطوة الثانية: ناديه وهو فاضي.
لما يكون مندمج في لعبة أو قدام الشاشة، طبيعي ما ينتبه.

الخطوة الثالثة: قولي اسمه، وبعده على طول شي يحبه.
"فهد، بسكوت!" والبسكوتة في يدك يشوفها.

الخطوة الرابعة: لا تناديه من آخر الصالة.
قربي منه، وانزلي لطوله، وعينك في عينه.

ولاحظي مع أي وحدة فيهم يلتفت لك أكثر.
هذي اللي تبدئي منها.
وإذا ما فحصتوا سمعه قبل، فحص السمع خطوة بسيطة وتستاهل.

الاسم جزء من تواصله، والتواصل واحد من ستة جوانب في يومه.
التقييم المجاني في البايو يمر عليها كلها.
pieces.notes:
**QA 82/100 · gate pass**

Concept is clever (his name has to compete with the fridge), and the end slide converts well. Cover crop is too tight to read as a fridge, and with 9 slides of the same layout the middle drags. Inconsistent fridge scale weakens the 'name grows louder' story.

**Push it higher:**
- Show more of the fridge on the cover (handle, magnets, a light spill) so it reads as a fridge at thumbnail size.
- Make the fridge recede monotonically and the bubble grow monotonically across s3-s8 so the scale story is unbroken.
- Vary at least two inner layouts (e.g. s6 close-up of the bubble only) to break the 9-slide sameness.

pieces.title: Coming back from the park starts when you arrive
onAsset_ar: كل رجعه من الحديقة نفس المعركة؟ جهزيه للخروج من اول ما توصلوا، مو آخر خمس دقايق.
هذي أربع أشياء تبدأ من أول ما تفرشوا الفرشه، عشان ما يحس إنكم فجأة قررتوا تمشوا.

أول ما تنزلوا من السيارة، وريه فين وقفتوا.
"هذي سيارتنا، نرجع لها بعدين."

ولما يقرب وقت الرجعة، لمّي الأغراض قدامه شوي شوي.
كيس الأكل أول، بعدين الألعاب، والفرشة آخر شي.

وخلي له شي يشيله بنفسه.
الكورة، أو شنطته الصغيرة، هو اللي يوديها للسيارة.

وخلي في السيارة شي يحبه، يلقاه أول ما يركب.
عصير، أو لعبة ما تطلع إلا في طريق الرجعة.
كذا لما تقولي يلا نمشي، يكون عارف إن وقت الخرجة خلص.
pieces.notes:
**QA 85/100 · gate pass**

One of the most distinctive covers: the pearl strip hook plus aerial map gives the grid a new shape. The story is easy to follow. The bright teal lawn is a lot of teal for a blue-led brand, and the dots get lost on it.

**Push it higher:**
- Darken the lawn to tealDeep (#007A77) or shrink it to ~45% so deep stays the dominant colour.
- Switch dots to ink or put them on a small pearl pill where they cross the lawn.
- On the end slide, show the blanket/bag already in the car so the payoff is visual, not just text.

pieces.title: Change isn't defiance: when someone else does bedtime
onAsset_ar: مو كل مرة يرفض فيها طفلك التغيير يعني إنه يعاندك. قبل ما تفرضي عليه التغيير، ابدئي بهذي الأربع خطوات.
كل ليلة إنتي تجهزيه للنوم. اليوم خالته موجودة، وأول ما قربت منه رفض يدخل الغرفة معاها.
هو متعود إنك إنتي اللي تجهزيه، وفجأة شخص ثاني أخذ مكانك.
الخطوة الأولى: لا تغيري الروتين كله. خلي وقت النوم وترتيب خطواته زي ما تعود.
الخطوة الثانية: لا تخلي التغيير مفاجأة. قولي له من بدري إن خالته بتساعده اليوم.
الخطوة الثالثة: خلي جزء من الروتين زي ما هو. لو متعود تقرأوا قصة، خليها معاكي.
الخطوة الرابعة: ابدئي بخطوة بسيطة. خلي خالته تساعده في لبس البيجامة، وإنتي كمّلي باقي الروتين.
تغيير شخص واحد ممكن يغيّر تجربة كاملة. التقييم المجاني يساعدك تشوفي جوانب مختلفه من يومه. الرابط في البايو.
pieces.notes:
**QA 85/100 · gate pass**

A confident type-led close to the grid that respects the pearl override (pearl ground, deep type). It reads well at phone size. Inner illustrations are a bit small and generic compared with the strength of the type.

**Push it higher:**
- Make the vignettes bigger and specific to the aunt (e.g. her gold chair beside his bed on s3, a calendar/sun icon on the door for s5).
- Reduce the gold offset to -5px 5px on body-size headlines so letter dots don't double up at small sizes.
- Add a single deep-blue band or panel to one inner slide to keep the post anchored to blue.
